title: AdvFidelity: Unifying Preference Alignment and Few-Step Image Generation within Reinforcement Learning

problem.summary: To address this gap, we propose AdvFidelity, which integrates artifact-sensitive fidelity supervision into RL through an online adversarial reward.
statements: To address this gap, we propose AdvFidelity, which integrates artifact-sensitive fidelity supervision into RL through an online adversarial reward.
This enables joint reward alignment and high-fidelity few-step generation within a single RL stage, without distribution matching distillation (DMD) or other explicit distillation objectives.
We train a discriminator to rank high-quality references (positives) above contentmatched reconstructions (negatives) produced by the current generator.
